period_note: SOUTH BANGLA AGRICULTURE AND COMMERCE BANK LIMITED (pre-2023 name). SOLO/STANDALONE basis, unaudited (no subsidiary existed yet -- SBAC Bank Investment Limited was not incorporated until 2021). Balance sheet is the 31-March-2017 period-end snapshot (reported), compared against 31-December-2016 (audited). Income-statement items are for Q1 itself (01 Jan 2017 to 31 Mar 2017; cumulative and discrete are identical for Q1). Total assets (48,850,348,928), total liabilities (43,057,025,289) and the Dec-2016 comparative column (total assets 45,599,984,613, total liabilities 39,983,653,842) all reconcile exactly against this bank's own existing 2016_Q4.json record (to within Tk.1-30, pure rounding). Total shareholders' equity (5,793,323,639) is independently reconciled two ways -- (a) total assets minus total liabilities, and (b) the sum of its own five reported equity components (paid-up capital 4,334,976,000 + statutory reserve 495,076,904 + other reserves 165,805,509 + current year's profit 121,377,318 + retained earnings, the last of which is itself back-solved as 676,087,908 since a paper fold obscured part of that printed cell but the Dec-2016 comparative column clearly shows 676,087,907, an near-identical brought-forward balance as expected) -- both methods agree exactly. NOTABLE FILING-FORMAT QUIRK, distinct from every quarter sourced in earlier passes (FY2016, FY2023-2025): this vintage of quarterly filing (FY2017-FY2020, confirmed across all three 2017 quarters) prints its own 'Earning per share (Annualized)' rather than a plain per-period EPS -- Q1's printed figure of 1.1200 is exactly PAT (121,377,318) / period-end shares (paid-up capital 4,334,976,000 / Tk.10 par = 433,497,600) x 4, i.e. the SAME x4 annualization convention this dataset already applies to Q1 cumulative figures elsewhere. eps_cumulative below is therefore back-derived (1.1200/4=0.28) to stay comparable with every other quarter in this dataset, which always stores the plain (non-annualized) cumulative EPS; the filing's own reported annualized figure is preserved in this item's note. No classified-loans/NPL, provision, capital-adequacy (CRAR/RWA/Tier1/Tier2) or NAV-per-share disclosure is present in this simple, short (5-page) filing -- no notes section at all, consistent with the FY2016 vintage already in this dataset; recorded as a gap. All balance-sheet and P&L subtotals reconcile exactly or to within Tk.1 (rounding) throughout.
